title: Mixed Event — The Tomorrow We Hope For — Episode7 Practice As Usual

meta.Event Outline: When Haruka stops by the shrine along her usual running route, she sees the shrine maiden who was there for her in her time of need collapse. In order to repay her for her kindness, Haruka decides to help out at the shrine in her stead.

rows.Line: Before dawn
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... Things are finally starting to calm down.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Great work so far, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori and Shizuku should be returning from their break soon, so let's take ours once they get back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds good. I just got a new heat pack out, but I still feel pretty chilly. It'll be nice to rest somewhere that's actually warm.
Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Haruka!
Nice shrine maiden outfit! It looks great on you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Haruka!
Let's make this year a good one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
An, Kohane...!
I wasn't expecting to see you two here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori told me about how you'll be volunteering as a shrine maiden here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still can't believe that An's best friends with Haruka Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I understand how you feel, but is it really that strange...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, she's someone you're supposed to see on TV and stuff instead of real life, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh?
Akito? Toya? You two are here too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm? Momoi?
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Can't you tell? I'm a shrine maiden!
We've decided to help out by volunteering as a group.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
As a group, huh...?
Hm? That means Hanasato's here too, right...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you know Minori?
But you're spot on. She, Haruka, Shizuku and I are all in a group called MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, An, I heard that you and your team gave Minori some pointers for singing at the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did!
Akito and Toya taught her a bunch of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I didn't know that.
Thanks a bunch, you two!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'd like to thank you both as well.
Minori said your advice helped quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
It was nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, teaching someone how to sing like that turned into a nice learning opportunity for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You guys sound just as passionate as An when it comes to singing. It's no wonder you're on the same team.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: By the way, where's Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's taking a break right now, but she should be back soon. Why don't you head over to the Omikuji booth later to let her know that you're here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, I will!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But first, let's go make our wishes!
se_event_prayer_2022_006

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, it's our turn!
You guys know what you're wishing for?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sure we'll all be wishing for the same thing... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I wanna make a wish too!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Me too!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, hold up. You guys can look around and stuff, but don't jump out like that. What if someone sees you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Would it be alright if I made a wish as well...?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku!
Would you like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I think we all should since we're here.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, we're up next!
Ready, everyone?!
se_event_prayer_2022_006
se_event_prayer_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to do everything I can to surpass RAD WEEKEND. Please keep watching over all of us...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(They all look so serious...
I'm guessing their wish has to do with that one event.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good luck, you guys...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, our year's officially started!
We just need to see Minori and it'll be mission accomplished!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why don't we stop and take a break around here? Hm...? Looks like they're handing out amazake.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Doesn't amazake have alcohol in it?
Is it okay for us to drink that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Some types of amazake are made like regular sake using sake yeast, while others are made from the remnants of the sake-making process.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The type of amazake that's handed out at shrines usually doesn't have any alcohol in it, so we should be fine.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Way to go, Toya! I never knew that!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I read it in a book.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sake, huh...?
That reminds me of the time MEIKO recommended whiskey to me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? Is that true, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You didn't offer alcohol to a minor, did you?!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Wait, is that true?
What kind of person are you?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! KAITO?! Luka?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You're both getting the wrong idea. I didn't offer anything to him. That was entirely a story of “what if...?”>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So... Have anything to say, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A minor drinking alcohol is a very serious crime...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I didn't drink anything!
It turned out to be oolong tea!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, breaktime's over.
Time to get back to work!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Minori's back from her break!
She's supposed to be over at the Omikuji booth, so why don't we all head over there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hi, Kohane!
I didn't know you were coming!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: With all of Vivid BAD SQUAD too...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hi, Minori!
It's pretty chilly out. I hope your shrine maiden outfit's keeping you warm.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It is! I even have hand warmers and heat packs to go along with it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, how does a fortune drawing sound? It's calmed down quite a bit, so now's your best chance!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Fortunes as in Omikuji...?
Sure, why not?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, it'll be a good test of luck.
I'll give it a go too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Great! We'll go one at a time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ready, guys?
We'll open them on three, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: One, two...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yay! A “great blessing”!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really? That's great, An!
Mine was a “blessing”.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I got a “good blessing”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmm... Mine's a “minor blessing”...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A “blessing” and “minor blessing” aren't that different, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be fair, most hierarchies naturally place “blessings” over “minor blessing”.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you can always draw another one if you're not happy with what you got!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Does anyone actually fall for that...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. These always have such interesting suggestions written in them too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, like this one... “Follow your heart...”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Follow your heart”...? So it's telling you to just do as you feel? That's pretty cool. It suits you perfectly, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Follow your heart, huh...?
Alright, how does practice sound after this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Interesting.
I was just thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha! So much for our day off!
We'd be back on schedule sooner than expected...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: At the same time, I guess that's sort of how we are!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's make this year a good one, you guys!
